result.title: EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments
result.summary: An LLM agent's cost and success depend on its model, its harness, and its environment. In addition to the widely studied directions of parameter tuning and harness optimization, we propose the third direction: optimization over stationary environments. Agents are often deployed in rich environments shared by many tasks, such as a company's Slack workspace or a complex collection of data sources, documents or tickets. We call these environments stationary environments. We introduce EnvOpt, a method for automated end-to-end optimization of stationary environments for any given model and harness, using real or synthetic tasks without needing any graders or reference answers. On AutomationBench, EnvOpt reduces the cost of Claude Haiku 4.5 by 72.7% and raises its pass rate by 14.34%. The same environment transfers to Opus 5, cutting its cost by 68.1% with a 1.34% gain. Added on top of Meta-Harness's optimized harness for Haiku 4.5, it lowers cost by a further 83.4% and adds 11.17% accuracy over Meta-Harness alone. Across 5 benchmarks, EnvOpt significantly reduces the cost of agents while improving or maintaining pass rate, and is transferable to different models and different harnesses. We also discuss common successful and rejected environment optimization strategies during automated optimization. More broadly, our results show that how information is represented to an agent shapes both its cost and its success, making the environment worth optimizing in addition to the parameters and the harness.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 EnvOpt，对 agent 所处的「静态环境」（如共享工作区、数据源、文档与工单集合）进行端到端自动优化，无需 grader 或参考答案，在多个基准上降低 agent 成本并提升或保持通过率，且优化后的环境可迁移到不同模型与 harness。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心观察「信息如何呈现给 agent 会影响成本与成功率」以及无参考答案的自动优化信号，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、可供 agent 获取的外部信息组织与无监督优化目标提供可核查线索，但该工作本身不涉及多模态 latent 推理。
